text: The checked chat helper documents a destructured options object containing window, webProgress and signal. Its abort listener rejects with CancelledError after cleanup; a matching redirect resolves then removes abort/progress listeners and closes the window. It also checks an already-loaded URI after installing listeners. Preserve that lifecycle when adjusting the callback type documentation; native web-progress flags and external authorization were not executed. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.
title: Keep interactive browser redirect cleanup tied to resolve and abort
